Cleaning robots · rented + serviced nationwide

Cleaning robots.

Floor-care robots that scrub, sweep, and vacuum large floors overnight or alongside your crew — covering the ground people would rather not.

A cleaning robot scrubs, sweeps, or vacuums large commercial floors on its own — overnight or alongside your crew — so your team covers more ground without the repetitive labor. Service Robot Co. rents the robot, deploys it, services it, and keeps a backup ready, across all 50 US states.

Request a quoteSee the lineup

Monthly rental — see rental pricing · read the commercial cleaning robots buyer guide.

What it is

A cleaning robot is an autonomous floor-care machine. It scrubs, sweeps, or vacuums a mapped area on a schedule, covering the large open floors that wear a cleaning crew down. Warehouses, retail floors, airports, and facilities use it to keep big spaces clean overnight or during a shift, so people focus on the detail work a robot can’t do.

Service Robot Co. owns the whole lifecycle. We pick the floor-care robot that fits your space, deploy it and map the cleaning plan, train your team, and keep it serviced — with a backup ready if one goes down. You rent a working machine, not a maintenance project.

Who rents it

The settings putting this robot to work.

  • Warehouses & 3PL
  • Retail
  • Airports & transit
  • Facilities
  • Hospitals & healthcare

What it does

Everything the unit does, in plain terms.

Covers the big floors

Scrubs, sweeps, and vacuums large open areas on a mapped plan — the repetitive ground that burns out a cleaning crew.

Runs overnight or on-shift

Cleans on a schedule after hours or alongside your team during the day, whichever fits your operation.

Frees people for detail work

The robot handles the open floor so your staff focus on restrooms, edges, and the spots a machine can’t reach.

Predictable monthly cost

Rent it by the month instead of buying. The service and the backup unit are on us, so a breakdown is not your downtime.

Where it earns its keep

Warehouses & distribution

Keep large concrete floors clean overnight without pulling staff off other work.

Retail & grocery

Maintain sales-floor shine on a schedule, day or night.

Airports & transit

Cover long concourses and high-traffic areas that never really close.

Facilities & campuses

Scrub corridors, lobbies, and common areas across a building or campus.

How Service Robot Co. backs it

We don’t just hand you a box. We rent it, deploy it, service it, and back it up — so the robot stays field-ready, not shelf-ware.

We rent it

Take the robot on a monthly rental with no purchase and no capital tied up in a machine you use part-time.

We deploy it

On-site setup, route or task configuration, and a walkthrough so the robot earns its keep from day one — not after a month on the shelf.

We service it nationwide

Repairs, parts, and support across all 50 US states. A robot that breaks is our problem to fix, not your downtime to eat.

We back it up

If a unit goes down, we swap it. You keep your schedule; we carry the spare.

Specs

We match the exact unit and its specs to your site and your job. Tell us what you need and we’ll confirm the model, capabilities, and rental terms. Get the details.

Common questions

What surfaces can a cleaning robot handle?
The floor-care robots we rent scrub, sweep, and vacuum large commercial floors. We match the unit to your surface and space during the site assessment, rather than assuming one machine fits every floor.
Can cleaning robots run overnight without staff?
Yes. They clean a mapped area on a schedule — overnight or alongside your crew. We deploy the unit, set the plan, and keep it serviced so it runs reliably without supervision.
Do we have to buy the robot?
No. You rent it by the month. Service Robot Co. owns the robot, deploys it, trains your team, services it, and keeps a backup — so the downtime risk stays with us.
Who maintains the robot?
We do. Service, repairs, and a backup unit are part of every rental. You run the work; we keep the robot field-ready.

Want one working for you?

Tell us the job and the site. We’ll match the cleaning robots, quote the rental, walk your team through it, and keep it serviced.
